title: Large language models in bioinformatics: a comprehensive survey.
authors: Meng, Zhigang; Yang, Zhikai; Zhu, Mingxun; Xu, Jianzhen
one_liner_zh: 综述了大型语言模型在生物信息学中的应用，涵盖蛋白质结构预测，但缺乏方法创新，属于宽泛综述。
abstract: The emergence of foundation models with trillion-level parameters has redefined the landscape of artificial intelligence. Various fields are developing their own large-scale models, which can solve many problems within the field and improve work efficiency. Biological large-scale models are a cross-disciplinary research field that combines mathematics, computer science, and biology, aiming to simulate and understand the structure, function, and dynamic changes of biological systems through the establishment of complex computational models. This field covers multiple levels such as biological pathways, population dynamics, protein folding, etc., providing us with tools for deep exploration of the mysteries of life and applications in medicine, ecology, and other fields. This article reviews the background and research status of biological large-scale models, and discusses future directions. Large language models (LLMs) and other large-scale foundation models have rapidly advanced in recent years, enabling powerful representation learning and generation across text, sequences, and multimodal data. In bioinformatics and biomedicine, these models are increasingly used to analyze genomic sequences, infer protein properties and structures, support drug discovery, and integrate heterogeneous biomedical evidence. This survey reviews the basic principles of LLMs and summarizes representative applications in (i) gene and genome sequence analysis, (ii) protein structure and function prediction, and (iii) drug design, including virtual screening and personalized medicine. We also discuss emerging multi-model modeling approaches, as well as key challenges such as data quality and privacy, interpretability, generalization to new organisms and tasks, and responsible deployment in health-related settings. Finally, we outline future directions for developing reliable, scalable, and explainable bioinformatics foundation models.
abstract_zh: 具有万亿级参数的基础模型的出现重新定义了人工智能的格局。各个领域正在开发自己的大规模模型，这些模型能够解决领域内的许多问题并提高工作效率。生物大规模模型是一个结合数学、计算机科学和生物学的跨学科研究领域，旨在通过建立复杂的计算模型来模拟和理解生物系统的结构、功能及动态变化。该领域涵盖生物通路、种群动力学、蛋白质折叠等多个层面，为我们提供了深入探索生命奥秘以及在医学、生态学等领域应用的工具。本文综述了生物大规模模型的背景和研究现状，并探讨了未来方向。近年来，大语言模型（LLMs）及其他大规模基础模型快速发展，实现了在文本、序列和多模态数据上的强大表征学习与生成能力。在生物信息学和生物医学中，这些模型越来越多地被用于分析基因组序列、推断蛋白质性质与结构、支持药物发现以及整合异质性生物医学证据。本综述回顾了LLMs的基本原理，并总结了其在以下方面的代表性应用：（i）基因与基因组序列分析，（ii）蛋白质结构与功能预测，以及（iii）药物设计，包括虚拟筛选和个性化医疗。我们还讨论了新兴的多模型建模方法，以及关键挑战，如数据质量与隐私、可解释性、对新生物体和新任务的泛化能力，以及在健康相关环境中的负责任部署。最后，我们概述了开发可靠、可扩展且可解释的生物信息学基础模型的未来方向。
